# Azure ML Workspace / AI Foundry — complete deep-dive reference

Curated by Skill Harbor — 💳 Paid cloud required: this needs an Azure subscription with billed Machine Learning compute usage — no usable free tier. @josiahsiegel's azure-ml-foundry-workspace skill, listed here with credit to its creator: an authoritative deep-dive reference for every aspect of Azure Machine Learning workspaces — the full resource hierarchy (workspace, hub, projects, compute, endpoints, registries), workspace creation via CLI and PowerShell, managed network isolation modes, private endpoints and DNS zones, a GPU VM SKU quick reference (A100, H100, H200, T4), endpoint deployment across managed online/batch/Kubernetes/serverless, managed identities and RBAC roles, ACR and storage integration, a complete `az ml` CLI and PowerShell cmdlet reference, Terraform provisioning, and troubleshooting error tables — with dedicated reference files per topic. Honest caveats: Microsoft renamed Azure AI Foundry to Microsoft Foundry (November 2025) and the platform is moving fast — portal names, SKU availability, and CLI flags will drift; GPU compute is expensive and quota-gated; never run the workspace-delete commands without understanding the --permanently-delete flag. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
